Eh.

It could be good, but a few typos early on (level 4 instead of Level 4, for example), the awkward phrasing of Source/Subject designations in the log, and the straight-up expungement of what could have been an interesting hook killed it for me.

-1. You've come a long way in a year, clearly, and a re-write to bring this up to par would do it some good.

item.content:encoded: I realize this is an older post and written to the standards at the time, but there is an awful lot of DATA EXPUNGING going on. The description of recovery might as well not exist for all the information given, and Incident 454-2 is just a generic "And then the D-Class EXPUNGED everyone to death because of EXPUNGED" event. Filling in a few of these missing details could do a lot for the piece, I believe.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I definitely like the idea of a dream-switching spider, but as already said, the expungement needs help. I do have some questions, though.

Do the sources regain dreams after a set amount of time, or do they never dream again? Are the hallucinations for long periods of time (equal to length of dream?) or just random short bursts? Do the sources remember the recurring dreams taken by the spiders? Is there an antidote for the dream loss?

I think this has a lot of potential to be fleshed out a bit more.
